description: The terminal artifact of a production. Records where the video went and under what conditions — including whether the custom thumbnail was actually accepted, because a silent fallback to an auto-selected frame changes CTR and would otherwise be invisible. Written by the publish worker, or by publish_adopted for an episode a human published by hand and which was later matched back to its run so it can be measured; the producer is the only thing distinguishing the two, so it is recorded rather than flattened.

target.description: Publish target id, e.g. "youtube". One of many possible destinations.

thumbnail_set.description: False means the platform refused the custom thumbnail and picked its own frame.
